title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq1Question: How do I enable Wizybot on my website?
faq1Answer:
To make Wizybot visible in your store, follow these steps in your Shopify admin:

- In the left menu, select Online Store.
- Open the Themes submenu.
- Click Customize.
- In the left sidebar, select the App embeds icon.
- Find Wizybot and turn the switch on.
- Important: Click Save in the top-right corner.

faq3Question: How do I correct a Wizybot reply?
faq3Answer:
If you want to adjust or improve the AI replies:

- Go to the app main menu and select Knowledge.
- From there, you can add or edit the information the bot uses to respond.
- If you need more help, you can write through your WhatsApp support group. If you do not have a group yet, contact us at: +57 350 256 6085.
